datasets: CinC 2017 (8,528 public recordings) used in-dataset (train/val/test) and cross-dataset (train on DiagnoStick or SPH, test on CinC; train on CinC, test on others); 'Noisy' recordings discarded, Normal+Other collapsed to noAF.
split: stratified 60% training / 20% validation / 20% testing per dataset (CinC: 5,117 / 1,706 / 1,705); hyperparameters by 5-fold CV on merged train+val
fs_hz: 300 (CinC, not resampled); features are R-R intervals
filter: none for CinC and DiagnoStick ('not further denoised')
normalisation: each patient's RR-interval collection normalised independently
input_len_s: whole recording (about 30-60 s for CinC) represented by its RR-interval distribution; recordings with <20 RRIs (CinC) discarded
segmenting: none (variable-length RRI sets)
loss_imbalance: SVM hinge loss; no imbalance handling stated
model_family: feature-based ML (distributional SVM on RR-interval kernel mean embeddings)
metric_primary: F1-score for AF (binary AF vs noAF) with accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, AUROC
metrics_other: AUROC; confusion matrices; training-set-size curves
reported_f1: 69.80 (train CinC, test CinC); 66.67 (train DiagnoStick, test CinC); 65.88 (train SPH, test CinC)
reported_other: sensitivity 75.36, specificity 96.11, AUROC 94.85 (CinC in-dataset)
seeds_n: 100 independent resamplings for training-size study; main results single
report_form: single (CV means with variance in Table 3)

title: Semantic ECG hash similarity graph
other_datasets: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia database (10,000 beat fragments, 4 classes)
datasets: CinC 2017 ('AF ECG dataset', 8,528 segments, 4 classes N/A/O/noise) used for training and testing of the semantic-hash similarity graph + FastGCN classifier; MIT-BIH Arrhythmia used for beat classification.
split: 7,000 randomly selected recordings for training (500 of them held out for validation); remaining 1,528 as test set
input_len_s: 30-60 s recordings as given (no segmentation stated)
segmenting: not stated
loss_imbalance: square loss for hash function learning; class imbalance acknowledged but no handling stated
model_family: other (semantic hashing + graph convolutional network, FastGCN)
metric_primary: average accuracy and macro-F1 over the four classes
metric_noise_included: true (macro-F1 over four groups including noise)
metrics_other: precision, recall, per-class accuracy, training/retrieval time
reported_other: precision 0.6259, recall 0.5781

title: Deep residual-dense network based on bidirectional recurrent neural network for atrial fibrillation detection
other_datasets: CPSC2018 (12-lead, single leads used; 6,877 recordings, 6:2:2 split)
datasets: Main development on CPSC2018 single leads; CinC 2017 Challenge data used for a tenfold cross-validation comparison against CNN-LSTM and OTE baselines (F1 over N, AF, O).
split: tenfold cross-validation on CinC 2017 (CPSC2018 split 6:2:2 = 4,125 / 1,375 / 1,377)
filter: noise reduction discussed (filter / wavelet) but applied method not specified
input_len_s: not stated
segmenting: not stated
loss_imbalance: cross-entropy; no imbalance handling stated
model_family: CNN-RNN (1-D DenseNet residual-dense blocks + bidirectional RNN with attention)
lr: 0.1, decayed x0.1 at 1/2 and 3/4 of training
metric_primary: F1 averaged over N, AF and Other (challenge score)
metrics_other: accuracy; sensitivity/specificity on CPSC2018 leads
reported_other: CPSC2018 single-lead: accuracy 97.72%, sensitivity 93.09%/93.55%, specificity 99.11%
